question: According to the 10-K disclosures, how many employees did Analog Devices, Advanced Micro Devices, Broadcom, and Texas Instruments each report, how many employees did Lam Research terminate under its restructuring plan, and which company or companies had the largest total workforce?
key_points: Analog Devices had approximately 24,500 employees as of November 1, 2025.
Advanced Micro Devices had approximately 31,000 employees as of December 27, 2025.
Broadcom had approximately 33,000 employees worldwide as of November 2, 2025.
Lam Research terminated approximately 1,760 employees under a restructuring plan through June 30, 2024; no total workforce figure is given.
Texas Instruments had about 33,000 employees worldwide as of December 31, 2025.

Broadcom and Texas Instruments have the highest reported total workforce at about 33,000 employees each, while Analog Devices has the lowest among the companies reporting a total workforce; Lam Research reports only a termination figure.

evidence.quote: As of November 1, 2025, we had approximately 24,500 employees, of whom approximately 13,000 are in engineering roles.
As of December 27, 2025, we had approximately 31,000 employees in our global workforce.
As of November 2, 2025, we had approximately 33,000 employees worldwide, with approximately 57% in research and development roles.
Under the plan, through June 30, 2024, the Company terminated approximately 1,760 employees, incurring expenses related to employee severance and separation costs.
At December 31, 2025, we had about 33,000 employees worldwide. Of those, about 90% were in R&D, sales or manufacturing.

question: As of their respective fiscal year-ends, how many employees did Advanced Micro Devices, Broadcom, NVIDIA, and Texas Instruments report, and which of these companies reported the largest workforce?
key_points: Advanced Micro Devices had approximately 31,000 employees as of December 27, 2025.
Broadcom had approximately 33,000 employees as of November 2, 2025.
NVIDIA had approximately 42,000 employees as of the end of fiscal year 2026.
Texas Instruments had about 33,000 employees as of December 31, 2025.
NVIDIA reported the largest workforce among these four companies.

evidence.quote: As of December 27, 2025, we had approximately 31,000 employees in our global workforce.
As of November 2, 2025, we had approximately 33,000 employees worldwide
As of the end of fiscal year 2026, we had approximately 42,000 employees in 38 countries
At December 31, 2025, we had about 33,000 employees worldwide.
